visualCharacteristics.purpose: search box and dropdown filters for the ASX releases list that follows it

contentPattern.structure: key/value rows: Search | placeholder; Category | all-label then options; Year | all-label then options, "auto", or a token like "2009+" (current year down to 2009); optional Target | CSS selector of items. Filters server-side when the list is a releases-list feed

reuseGuidance: Place directly before the list it filters, in the same section. Filters by text match and keeps state in the URL.
